replacements.before: For kids: Always check that pajamas are either snug-fitting or flame-resistant (required by US safety standards). Snug-fit cotton is the most popular choice for children’s sleepwear.
replacements.after: For kids: Choose size-appropriate sleepwear and follow its safety label and intended fit. Check the product details rather than assuming that a fabric or a daytime outfit is suitable for sleeping. The CPSC children’s sleepwear guide explains why oversized, loose-fitting cotton sleepwear can be a hazard.
